rationale: Independent sampling of HEAD eebf4654… (threshold_provided:false; no pass bar provided or applied) shows ContinuityOps as a coherent repo-only reliability lab. plan-approval.json is fresh-council-remediation and aligned with PLAN/STATUS; validators and local tests (Helm chart, serverless unit, alert schema, unsafe proposals) are green; digest pins and worker.zip match packaged sources; claims and synthetic restore/load artifacts are honestly labeled. Residual gaps are evidence SHA lag behind HEAD, public Stage-2 stop-language in docs, thin observability TF/dashboards, and unmeasured synthetic resilience numbers — disclosed lab limitations, not qualitative reasons to withhold merge of this ContinuityOps folder. Orchestrator applies any private gate after scoring; this opinion is merit-only.
